title: A Memoir Blue
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#699, 2026-10-26), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal environment, msync, rated 5 of 5 after playing it through in 73 minutes at 1080p. Its first start ran through DXMT and the second through D3DMetal, both fine. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Played start to finish on the default engine on an M1, beautifully at 1080p by the reporter's account, on DXMT and on Apple's DirectX 12 support. Quitting the game does not exit cleanly. On DXMT the game offered 4K while the Metal HUD showed 1080p, and on Apple's DirectX 12 support it offered 1080p at most. Nothing was measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: Quitting the game does not end it cleanly
